scope: Digital asset control, reachable-history secret evidence, recovery and transfer continuity

controls.name: reachable_history_secret_scan
controls.closeEvidence: clean current-main workflow run with zero unclassified fingerprints

controls.name: github_company_control
controls.closeEvidence: company-controlled organization/repository ownership, recovery and continuity evidence

controls.name: production_infrastructure_control
controls.closeEvidence: company/transaction control, billing, administrators, recovery and backup evidence

controls.name: domain_dns_registrar_control
controls.closeEvidence: canonical registrant/admin/recovery inventory and transfer/control evidence

controls.name: vendor_billing_recovery
controls.closeEvidence: material vendor account, billing and recovery ownership record

controls.name: privileged_secret_control
controls.closeEvidence: vault metadata, privileged credential owner, rotation and recovery evidence without secret values

controls.name: two_admin_continuity
controls.closeEvidence: two-admin or equivalent tested continuity coverage for launch-critical systems

controls.name: backup_recovery_drill
controls.closeEvidence: dated recovery/backup drill evidence for material systems

doneRule: RT-005 may be DONE only when all controls are closed with current evidence and the final ownership/control model matches the intended transaction state.
